info.name: P2P · Sourcing Management Tracker (/api/p2p/sourcing-targets)
info.description:
Sourcing Management Tracker → Sourcing Target Management (the RFQ tab is not part of this collection).
Same targets and APIs as Bulk Sourcing — the tracker only shows them with "Sourcing" wording.

Run order: 0. Auth → 2. form data (fills assignee / product ids) → 3. Assign Target → 1. list → 4. report → 5. Map Supplier Directory → 6. Convert to Supplier.
Roles: the CREATOR edits the target; the ASSIGNEE maps suppliers. Log in as the assignee for folder 5.
Map Supplier: Domestic supplier (₹ unit price + GST, CGST + SGST or IGST) or International supplier (price in its currency × exchange rate, no GST); every mapping stores its quote.
Every main request has a saved example response; Postman's Code (</>) → cURL gives the curl command.

variable.description: Set by ASSIGN TO · team members
International Supplier Master row · set by supplier lists
New Supplier directory id · set by Mapped suppliers
Supplier Master id saved by the Add Supplier form

item.name: 0. Auth
item.description:
Run first — stores {{token}}.
NOTE: /api/login revokes the user's other tokens. Use a test user.

item.name: 1. Sourcing Target list (3 tabs)
item.description:
ONE common list API for the three tabs — change only `tab`.
• tab = all → All Sourcing Targets (created by me + assigned to me, each once)
• tab = created → Sourcing Target Created by Me
• tab = assigned → Sourcing Target Assigned to Me
Optional: q (search: target ID, source, created by, assignee, status, product names) · status (In Progress | Completed | Overdue) · page · per_page (≤200, default 10).

data.counts {all, created, assigned} = the three badges (always all three, not affected by search).
data.rows[] columns: id (Sourcing Target ID) · start (date under the ID) · sources[] (I Want to Source To: Product Master / Manual Entry) · due + overdue (Procurement TAT + OVERDUE pill) · createdBy · assignee · firstProduct + moreProducts (Total Products "Ball Valve 1.5\" +12") · products / totalProducts (total) · completed / completedProducts (products marked Completed) · pending · progress (number 0–100) + progressPercent (text, e.g. "25%") · progressStatus (In Progress | Completed) · mappedSuppliers (total suppliers mapped across all products of the target).
Without `tab` the endpoint returns the old Bulk Sourcing shape { assigned[], created[] } — unchanged.

Response envelope for every request in this module: { "status": true, "data": … }. Errors: { "message", "errors" } (422) or { "status": false, "message" } (403).

request.description:
ASSIGN TARGET button. Body (JSON):
• due_date — required · SOURCING TAT (YYYY-MM-DD, today or later)
• assignee_id — required · ASSIGN TO (an id from GET /p2p/team-members)
• source — required · master | manual (the I WANT TO SOURCE FROM radio that was picked first)
• products[] — required, at least 1 (the PRODUCT LIST; Masters + Manual can be mixed)
   – from — required · master | manual
   – code — required when from = master (code from GET /p2p/products)
   – name — required when from = manual · PRODUCT NAME
   – target_price — required when from = manual (optional for master) · TARGET PRICE (₹) e.g. 1200 · 1,200 · 1200.50
   – clarity — optional · { type: text | link | pdf, val } (pdf val = path from POST /p2p/upload; several paths newline-joined)
START DATE is always today (set by the server). The ID is allocated on save.
Response: { status: true, data: { id: "SRC-008" } }.

response.name: 200 OK

item.name: 6. Convert to Supplier (New Supplier → Supplier Master)
item.description:
"Convert to Supplier" on a New Supplier card: register it in the Supplier Master with the normal Add Supplier form, then link it.
1. GET …/convert → pre-filled form data · 2. save with the existing /vendors/step/* wizard · 3. POST …/convert { vendor_id } → its mappings become Supplier Master rows.

Response envelope for every request in this module: { "status": true, "data": … }. Errors: { "message", "errors" } (422) or { "status": false, "message" } (403).

request.description:
new_supplier_id = supplier_id of a "New Supplier" row from Mapped suppliers (canConvert = true).
identity → POST /vendors/step/identity fields (company_name, legal_name, primary_email, segment_id, gst_applicable = No for International).
address → PUT /vendors/{id}/step/contacts primary address (address_line, country_id, state_id, state_code, city, google_location, contact_name, contact_no, email).
Ids are looked up by name; null when the master has no match (pick it in the form).
